name: zclass_world_set_origin
description: zClass_World::gwWorldSetOrigin stores the world X/Z origin and recomputes the max X/Z bounds from the current size.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass world/source-cluster pass that includes the adjacent size, partition, and grid setup helpers.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x450c00 validates the leaf world-data access through node->classData, stores originX and originZ, computes worldMaxX as worldSizeX + originX, computes worldMaxZ as worldSizeZ + originZ, returns 0, and has no direct callees.
The native smoke verifies stored X/Z origins and recomputed max bounds from non-zero existing world sizes.
